Heard on IA No.2768/2019, an application moved on behalf of appellant under Section 5 of the Limitation Act for condonation of delay.
2. On due consideration and for the reasons mentioned in the application, the same is allowed.
3. Delay in filing the instant appeal, is hereby condoned.

4. This appeal by appellant/claimant u/S. 173 (1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 is arising out of the award dated 28/02/2019 passed by Fourteen Additional, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal (in short "Claims Tribunal") Gwalior (M.P.) in Claim Case No.261/2017 on account of inadequacy of compensation and seeking enhancement of compensation.

5. The date of accident, negligence and the issue of liability are not in NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2026:MPHC-GWL:10591 2 MA-3420-2019 dispute and the findings recorded by the Claims Tribunal in this regard are not in question.

6. As per findings of the Claims Tribunal, in the case of injury sustained by claimant in motor accident, an amount of compensation to the tune of Rs.97,000/- has been awarded by the Claims Tribunal with interest from filing of claim petition till its realization.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant submits that Claims Tribunal has committed grave error in awarding the amount.

He further submits that Claims Tribunal has awarded the compensation is on lower side and, hence, it is prayed that compensation amount be enhanced and just and reasonable amount of compensation may be awarded.
8. On the other hand, learned counsel for the Insurance Company contended that the amount awarded by the Claims Tribunal is just and proper and needs no enhancement.
He supported the findings recorded by the Claims Tribunal and prays for dismissal of the appeal.

9 . After hearing learned counsel for the parties and perusal of the record as well as looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, more particularly the injuries sustained by claimant, it would be appropriate to enhance compensation to the tune of Rs.40,000/-.
10. Accordingly, present appeal is allowed in part to the extent indicated herein above.

The amount of compensation is enhanced to lump sum amount of Rs.40,000/-(Rupees Fourty Thousand Only)
in the present NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-GWL:10591 3 MA-3420-2019 appeal.
The appellant is entitled to receive Rs.40,000/- in addition to the amount already awarded by the Claims Tribunal.
The enhanced amount shall carry interest as awarded by the Claims Tribunal from the date of deposit of court fee.
All other findings recorded by the Claims Tribunal shall remain intact.
11. The present appeal stands disposed of.

(HIRDESH) JUDGE Prachi Bharat @ Bhavesh vs Yogendra on 31 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/102194080/
